Tap below to leave a quick review.

Thank you for supporting us.

category_contract.source: provider-assigned category returned by the first all-approved readback
category_contract.rule: Record every assigned category without assuming the submission category, then block any later readback that differs from that explicit lock.

red: Ten contract failures proved the review SID, partial production configuration, exact native action, and provider preflight were absent.
Two follow-up failures proved malformed action origins and variable-ending bodies were not rejected.
tdd.green: 29 focused tests passed across release preflight, provider-assigned category locking, runtime env, and production env schema.

safe_readback.credential_source: Vercel production env pulled to a mode-600 temporary file and deleted by EXIT trap; API key values were never printed.
safe_readback.command: curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body -u "$TWILIO_API_KEY_SID:$TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET" "https://content.twilio.com/v1/Content/$CONTENT_SID/ApprovalRequests" | jq -c '{sid, whatsapp: (.whatsapp | {name, status, category, content_type, rejection_reason})}'
safe_readback.projection: jq {sid, whatsapp: {name, status, category, content_type, rejection_reason}}
safe_readback.poll_policy: Read-only polling only. Do not set any production sender or Content SID until every selected status is approved and every rejection_reason is empty. Capture the provider-assigned categories from that all-approved readback as the category lock; subsequent readbacks must match it.

blockers: All four lifecycle templates are pending.
The review template is pending and not yet approved.
Production sender and all five Content SID values remain blank or absent by design.
pii: No recipient or sender phone number is retained in this artifact.
